description: Settings and fallback assumptions of notebooks/full_planner.ipynb. Change a value here and re-run the notebook.

cold_start_colony.description: Attack origin and universe speed used only while state/spaceinvasion.db has no planet snapshot.

table_level_caps.description: Highest level listed per entity in buildings_levels_df and technologies_levels_df.

empire.description: Planet roster of Sections 6 and 8. 'max_planets' counts normal planets; 11 is the default of the bot's own colony cap (StrategyConfig.max_planets in backend/core/config.py) and the 'typically 11 base' of docs/specifications/05-fleet-missions-and-progression.md. Every planet still missing becomes a generic planet (an empty colony slot) with 'empty_colony_fields' fields at 'empty_colony_temperature_c'; the catalog and level tables of Section 6 are computed for such a planet. 'fallback_planet_fields' is the size assumed for an owned planet whose size was not recorded.

flight_time_fallback.description: Assumptions of the rough flight-time estimate, which is used only for attacks that have no observed dispatch-to-impact time.
